limitations: Available-sample ranking, not complete S&P 500 top ten.
Possible survivorship, ticker-recycling, corporate-action and delisting gaps.
Adjusted close is a return proxy, not verified CRSP total return.
Both year-end trading dates required; no partial calendar-year substitution.
Any observed adjacent adjusted-close move above 50% in absolute value quarantines that security-year pending review. Genuine extreme moves may also be excluded.
2023-2025 use Kaggle close ratios with undocumented adjustment, not verified dividend-inclusive total returns.
Recent price availability is drawn from surviving/current members, intersected with each historical year-end member list. Missing former members cause selection bias.
Kaggle incremental refresh may splice adjustment conventions; adjacent moves over 50% exclude a security-year. Smaller source errors may remain.
THC 2010-12-10 event exception: takeover proposal confirmed in SEC exhibit; observed 55% move retained. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/70318/000119312510277954/dex991.htm
Missing 2023/2024 endpoints supplemented from Chickenrobot CC0 snapshot; close ratios, not certified total returns.
IR 2017-2019 removed pending permanent-identity reconciliation: historical constituent IR and modern IR price history are different companies.
Cross-source annual differences above 0.5 percentage points are recorded in integrity audit; donors are not averaged or silently overwritten.
Cross-source annual differences above 0.5 percentage points are quarantined until conventions are reconciled; donors are never averaged or silently substituted.
